paragraphs: Chapter 836
Episode 209. The Seventh Tomb of Temar - Keitam's Picture (9)
[You... You have the energy of Changseong.]
The fake Murakan covered his chest wound with spirit energy and spoke.
Jin had indeed received that energy from Ron during the Sword Emperor Shrine incident, but what cut the fake's heart now was purely the power of the Spirit Sword.
[No, no. It's not me, it's you who cut it. If it was me in my heyday, that wouldn't be enough. You're a cheap fake.]
The recovered fake seemed to have no visible damage.
However, no matter how small, a fragment fallen from the heart signifies a permanent loss.
From now on, the fake was no longer invincible against Jin and his party.

However, they did not forget the fact that they had to be even more careful. Even if he was a fake, the opponent was Murakan as depicted in his heyday. Of course, he may not measure up to the real him as per Murakan's words, but he certainly had enough power to end the entire world inside the picture.
Bradamante was again soaked with dark spirit energy. The Demon Sword Technique unleashed by Frei, the Wrath of Hamalen, was now focusing the wide spread chill on the fake.
And the moment the fake tried to move, Dranax and Viola simultaneously unfolded their Demon Sword Techniques.
Runkandel Demon Sword Technique
Hell Phantom Sword - Dranax Runkandel
Wind Divine Sword - Viola Runkandel
Dranax's demon sword held fire, Viola's demon sword held wind. The swords of the two who leaped to the left and right formed techniques while spreading a vast fire and wind respectively.

The Hell Phantom was a sword that took full advantage of the properties of the chain sword. The extended sword blade instantly wrapped around the fake, raising a red sword screen. The fake couldn't move as he wanted because of the chain sword hitting his body relentlessly, and his wings being torn.
The only way to defeat the Hell Phantom Sword is to strike Dranax directly with a stronger and faster blow.
The fake, however, was able to aim at Dranax while simply enduring the damage of the Hell Phantom based on his recovery power, but even that was blocked by Viola's demon sword.
The Wind God.

Viola was the first and last knight to have the great epithet of 'Wind' as an attribute. After the history of Runkandel's demon sword was interrupted, the epithet of wind was always applicable only to wizards, primarily contractors of Meljaier.

However, Viola was the only person who claimed the name of Wind God without the help of gods. It was him who freely converted the sword wind launched by the Ten Great Knights in aerial combat, and it was him who 'cut off' the ability of the fake to create wind and mobilize.
Although it was invisible, Jin could recognize it in an instant. The fact that Viola's sword was controlling the wind and absorbing it into the sword blade.

The wind absorbed by Violro transformed into a sword wind whenever he willed, shredding the impostor's entire body. The three attributes of the magic swords, spread by the Ten Knights, ensnared the impostor.
They hadn't unfolded their magic swords to deal a fatal blow. The swords were solely to bind the impostor.
The only one who could deal a fundamental blow to him was Jin. Jin, like Temar of that era, was receiving the assistance of the Ten Knights.
"Kraaaah!"

Murakan joined the Ten Knights. He approached while continuously breathing from a distance where the Ten Knights would not be harmed, and at close range, he tangled with the impostor, tearing him apart like mad, swinging his forelegs, wings, and tail.
Inevitably, the magic sword skills hit Murakan as well, but the Ten Knights adjusted it appropriately so it wasn't a severe impact.

Jin watched the combatants while maintaining a posture that could release his sword energy at any moment. While Murakan and the Ten Knights were restraining him, it was judged better to snipe with his sword energy rather than go in directly and target his heart.
This strategy was possible because they all had faith in each other and had the ability to predict each other's attack routes.
"The center is Frey's magic sword skill. However, since the energy has weakened compared to the beginning, it seems to be a form of restraint with Murakan's curtain leading the way."
As expected, as soon as Hamalen's anger faded, the Ten Knights flexibly changed their combined attack as if they had agreed in advance.

Instead, Frey aimed at the impostor's rear without stopping, riding on Violro's sword wind with Murakan. There were only restrictions on discharging a large amount of aura and magic power through the magic sword skill, but each of her blows contained the class of top superhumans.
"Kaaaah!"
As Dranax screamed and started the climax of the Hell Phantom Sword, a single black sword energy streaked across the sky.
Jin's Soul Slash had precisely cut the impostor's chest. It did not drop pieces like before, but the Soul Slash undoubtedly destroyed a part of his heart.
'Even if it's slow, it will eventually be completely shattered.'
There would be a remaining card for the impostor.

However, it couldn't be predicted. Jin didn't know many of Murakan's skills. From the start, when Murakan recalled his heyday, he usually just ripped apart through overwhelming power rather than special skills.
'Energy release, Black Chain, or an enhanced version of Breath, there could be something else. Murakan has almost no memory of his heyday.'
Displacement.
The second Soul Slash split the battlefield. Murakan and the Ten Knights momentarily dispersed and switched to long-range attacks whenever Jin fired the Soul Slash.
This time too, the Soul Slash did not miss the heart. The black sword energy broke through somewhere in the heart, pierced the back, and came out.
"Kraaaaak!"

The impostor fell to the ground, spewing out dimmed energy. The Hell Phantom Sword, burning red, wrapped around his right leg, and Violro pushed all the wind held in the sword blade at once into his fall.
The storm destroyed part of the building, forming a huge pit, and the shockwave destroyed the walls.
For the first time, Jin leaped up and fired Soul Slayer into the pit from mid-air before the fake could emerge.

Even though his vision was blocked, the black sword aura, which had grown to its limit, was bound to touch the heart no matter where it hit. The sword aura was seen bending and twisting as it was blocked by something solid.
Soon, Jin landed on the ground, catching his breath. His sweat-soaked hair felt heavy, and his head was numb from the intense concentration he had just exerted.
The fake was still alive.
The cessation of the attack was merely a pause for breath, and his comrades continued to keep a keen watch on the pit.
The fake, who emerged from the pit in an instant by shattering the ground, was wobbling like a mirage.
The aura he was spreading around him repeatedly formed and extinguished unstably, and his semi-transparent chest revealed a black heart that was chipped and exploded here and there.
Despite the appearance of having suffered a severe blow.
A strange sense of unease was creeping over the comrades. The intuition that if they tried to finish him off now, they would be met with a backlash.
[Hehehehe…….]
The fake let out a chilling laugh after belching out his aura.
[What, did you give up? Huh?]
[Murakan... I suddenly understand why I am here. Thinking of myself as you.]

At his words, the comrades' eyes widened. The Ten Knights, in particular, had to suppress their emotions for a moment, because of their resentment against Murakan. Although they had rekindled their faith by fighting alongside the real Murakan, hearing it directly from the fake was a completely different feeling.
[Yes, finally you admit that you're a cheap fake. You must have had a hard time imitating me. Now get hit and die... oh, you're persistent. So you want to resist till the end, huh?]
The aura of the fake Murakan was amplifying. His blurry body turned back to black and dense, and a pair of new wings formed on his back.

The two horns growing out of his head grew bigger, and his pumpkin-colored eyes flared like fire. It was another state of Murakan that most of Jin and the Ten Knights had never seen directly, and even Murakan himself did not remember.
Murakan began to feel a severe headache as he watched the fake transform.
[Argh... my head is, damn.]
It was because of his memories. Murakan was recalling memories of a thousand years ago that he had forgotten from the transformed figure of the fake.
He was recalling the days he didn't want to remember, the days he desperately wanted to forget.
Jin did not take his eyes off Murakan and the fake Murakan, tense.
'Just like the day I first met Orgal, Murakan's condition has drastically worsened. Furthermore, I can't help but think that the fake's power is not ordinary. Some sort of... awakening?'
He couldn't rashly start an attack first.
There was no weakness left in the fake Murakan now, and everywhere that his gaze and aura touched was no different from his territory.
Even if he cut the heart with Soul Slayer, it was questionable if he could inflict damage as before. This was a reproduction of the real Murakan from that era.
[Argh…!]
[Murakan… It must be painful. You have amusingly believed all along that all this, the numerous massacres and destructions I committed, were all mere lies.]
[Shut up! I never did such things…!]

[No, you committed numerous massacres. You killed innocent humans like bugs, executed knights of the house, stabbed in the hearts of colleagues you trusted, and in the end tried to harm your contractor.]
That is the truth, Murakan.

As soon as the fake finished speaking, Murakan charged forward, releasing his aura. But as he lost his senses for a moment, he seemed to get fatally injured by the fake's power. He started an attack without protecting himself at all.

Without a choice, Jin and the Ten Great Knights threw their bodies to protect Murakan simultaneously. Black chains rained from the fake's aura curtain spread endlessly in the sky, and Jin and the Ten Great Knights could protect Murakan by parrying almost all of them.
However, they couldn't prevent one black chain from piercing Frey's back. Pierced by the chain, Frey was fixed in mid-air and stopped moving.
She didn't die, but a black lump was seen coming out of Frey's body and being absorbed into the chain. It was her shadow.
“Frey!”
“Lady Frey!”
Murakan, still out of his senses, continued to attack the fake, but the fake easily blocked his approach with his aura curtain, as if it was amusing.

[Frey is about to die now. Even if you cut off the chain, once pierced, she can't avoid a certain death. A thousand years ago, Frey died at your hands, don't you remember yet? Will you keep denying the truth?]
Jin bent the chain that pierced Frey, then parried other chains flying towards Murakan.
[Murakan, among the things I did reproducing you from a thousand years ago, there is only one thing you didn't do personally. Like this… Completely tearing down the Storm Fortress.]
Ultimate Move of the Black Dragon
Advent of Darkness
The fake was unfolding Murakan's ultimate move that had been forgotten.
